title: The Nature Club
subtitle: 考点：一般现在时 / 自然与野生动物
passage: Ben is interested in nature, so he joined the nature club. Every weekend, the members hike in the hills. They take photos of wild animals and collect small insects.
They discover many new things. Ben falls in love with wildlife. "The club is more than a hobby," he says. "It makes me understand the world."
